content:
Good news for Apple Card Savings account users this morning. Apple and Goldman Sachs raised the account's interest rate from 3.4% to 3.5% today.

Apple and Goldman Sachs periodically adjust the annual percentage yield of the Apple Card Savings account based on overall financial conditions.

This rate matches what Goldman Sachs offers on its own Marcus savings account, but through this link you can earn a promotional 4.50% APY for a limited time.

The Apple Card Savings account is exclusively available to Apple Card users. When you earn Daily Cash with your Apple Card, you can route the cashback to your savings account or deposit it directly into the account.

In addition to transferring Daily Cash directly, Apple Card users can also deposit funds from a linked bank account or an Apple Cash balance. Interest compounds daily, meaning you not only earn returns on your principal but also on the accumulated interest itself. Accrued interest is deposited directly into your savings account at the end of each month.

For more detailed information about the Apple Card Savings account, please refer to our complete guide.
